subject.title: feat: model-centric usage & spend view across providers (Scope B from #2257)

question: Should CodexBar accept Scope B’s exact-name cross-provider model aggregation and the associated 365-day dashboard history collection as the supported product boundary?
rationale: The linked design issue deliberately leaves model identity, duplicate accounting, cost semantics, and UI placement to maintainer judgment; the PR chooses one MVP boundary but cannot establish that this is the intended permanent product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded MVP
options.body: Accept exact normalized model-name aggregation as an explicitly limited view, while requiring a safe default-history loading strategy or performance proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to provider-scoped models
options.body: Keep model presentation within provider data until canonical identity and duplicate-accounting policy are designed separately.

options.title: Defer Scope B
options.body: Keep the design discussion open and revisit the model-centric surface after maintainers set a cross-provider identity strategy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded MVP
recommendation.body: Accept exact normalized model-name aggregation as an explicitly limited view, while requiring a safe default-history loading strategy or performance proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the open feature discussion make steipete the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
